name: Sesame Cucumber Salad
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 side-dish servings based on 2 medium cucumbers (≈600g) as primary ingredient, typical for similar cucumber salad recipes.
Total time estimated at 15 minutes: ≈10 min for peeling, quartering, seeding if needed, and crosswise cutting plus ≈5 min for tossing with seasonings; no cooking required.
Seasoned rice vinegar treated as containing possible trace soy from fermentation/seasoning but not explicitly listed, hence null for Soy allergen.
All other ingredients are plant-based with no animal products, confirming vegetarian/vegan/pescatarian/dairy-free compatibility.
Gluten-free confirmed as no barley/rye/wheat or uncertified oats; rice vinegar is gluten-free by nature.
Sesame present via sesame oil and seeds; no other allergens explicitly listed or implied.
instructions:
Prep the cucumbers:
Peel the cucumbers. Cut them into quarters, lengthwise. (If the seeds are bitter, scrape out the seeds and discard.) Cut the cucumbers again, crosswise, into 1/2-inch thick pieces.

Toss the salad:
Place cucumbers into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Toss with sesame oil, seasoned rice vinegar, basil (if using), and chili flakes. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds if using.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium cucumbers ≈ 600g total edible weight after peeling and seeding if needed; standard values for raw cucumber.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp table salt weighs ≈3g; sodium chloride contributes zero macros.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp sesame oil weighs ≈9g; typical pure sesame oil values.

ingredients.name: Rice Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 Tbsp seasoned rice vinegar ≈30g (slightly sweetened/salted variety); low-calorie estimate based on typical Asian seasoned vinegar.

ingredients.name: Basil Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: 6 fresh basil leaves ≈10g; standard fresh basil leaf nutrition, optional but included as listed.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli Flakes
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp red chili flakes weighs ≈1g; typical dried chili flake values.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp toasted sesame seeds weighs ≈6g; standard toasted sesame seed nutrition.
